description: MySQL query/utility DML acceptance: SELECT family (joins, subqueries, locking, INTO), UNION, TABLE/VALUES/WITH and set-ops (8.0+ forms pinned offline and via metadata), HANDLER/CALL/LOAD DATA/LOAD XML/IMPORT TABLE boundaries.

ddl_steps.name: drop-stale-fixture
ddl_steps.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t52fx; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t52fx_b

ddl_steps.name: create-fixtures
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t52fx (id INT PRIMARY KEY, a INT, b VARCHAR(20)) ENGINE=InnoDB; CREATE TABLE t52fx_b (id INT PRIMARY KEY, b VARCHAR(20)) ENGINE=InnoDB

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='golden' AND table_name IN ('t52fx','t52fx_b')

ddl_steps.name: create-meta-fixture
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t52m (id INT PRIMARY KEY, a INT) ENGINE=InnoDB; INSERT INTO t52m VALUES (1,5)

ddl_steps.name: seed-rows
ddl_steps.sql: INSERT INTO t52fx VALUES (1,10,'x'),(2,20,'y'); INSERT INTO t52fx_b VALUES (1,'bx'),(2,'by')

verify.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM golden.t52fx)+(SELECT count(*) FROM golden.t52fx_b)

ddl_steps.name: select-join
ddl_steps.sql: SELECT u.a, v.b FROM t52fx u JOIN t52fx_b v ON u.id=v.id ORDER BY u.id

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM golden.t52fx u JOIN golden.t52fx_b v ON u.id=v.id

ddl_steps.name: select-for-update
ddl_steps.sql: SELECT a FROM t52fx WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE

ddl_steps.name: union
ddl_steps.sql: SELECT a FROM t52fx UNION ALL SELECT 99 ORDER BY 1

ddl_steps.name: load-data-missing-file
ddl_steps.sql: LOAD DATA INFILE '/nonexistent-t52.csv' INTO TABLE t52fx

ddl_steps.name: load-xml-missing-file
ddl_steps.sql: LOAD XML INFILE '/nonexistent-t52.xml' INTO TABLE t52fx

ddl_steps.name: cleanup
ddl_steps.sql: DROP TABLE t52fx; DROP TABLE t52fx_b
